claims.text: For every bigrassmannian \(v_{r,s,t,n}\), with \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\), \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), and \(b=\min(i,j)\), \(J_v\subseteq\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) is minimally generated by \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 220-235]

For \(A=\Lambda/I_{5,5}\), \(J=\bigoplus_{333\subseteq\lambda\subseteq5^5}\mathbb Z\bar s_\lambda\), and \(Q=J/A_+J\), the ranks in weights \(9,\ldots,25\) are \((1,1,2,2,2,1,1,0,\ldots,0)\), and every torsion list is empty. [artifact b5658ec18b84ad470751544a752f238dadd447fb7b1122a89a299a79e024042f]

If a homogeneous family \(F\) generates a graded \(A\)-module \(J\), and every \(Q_d=(J/A_+J)_d\) is torsion-free with \(\operatorname{rank}_{\mathbb Z}Q_d=\#F_d\), then the images of \(F_d\) form a \(\mathbb Z\)-basis of \(Q_d\).
For \(i=j=b=3\), \(a=2\), the lower-adjoined family has degree enumerator \[ z^9\!\!\sum_{\rho\subseteq3^2}z^{|\rho|} =z^9(1+z+2z^2+2z^3+2z^4+z^5+z^6) =z^9\binom52_z. \]

Minimality alone does not imply the indecomposables-basis criterion: for \(A=\mathbb Z[x]\), \(A_+=(x)\), and \(J=(2x,x^2)\), the homogeneous generators \(2x,x^2\) are minimal, whereas \[ J/A_+J\cong\mathbb Z\{2x\}\oplus(\mathbb Z/2)\{x^2\}. \]
